"""Castellano custom format and quality profile for Radarr and Sonarr.

What TRaSH does not cover (no Spanish CFs in the guides) and recyclarr
cannot define (trash_ids only) lives here instead. Idempotent.
"""

import json
import os
import urllib.request

CF_NAME = "Castellano"
PROFILE_NAME = "Castellano"
SCORE = 10000
QUALITIES = ["HDTV-1080p", "WEBRip-1080p", "WEBDL-1080p", "Bluray-1080p"]
CUTOFF = "Bluray-1080p"

# All three must hold: spanish audio named, and neither latino nor VOSE.
SPECIFICATIONS = [
    {
        "name": "Castellano en el titulo",
        "implementation": "ReleaseTitleSpecification",
        "negate": False,
        "required": True,
        "fields": [{"name": "value", "value": "(?i)\\b(castellano|español|espanol|spanish|esp)\\b"}],
    },
    {
        "name": "Sin latino",
        "implementation": "ReleaseTitleSpecification",
        "negate": True,
        "required": True,
        "fields": [{"name": "value", "value": "(?i)\\b(latino|lat)\\b"}],
    },
    {
        "name": "Sin VOSE",
        "implementation": "ReleaseTitleSpecification",
        "negate": True,
        "required": True,
        "fields": [{"name": "value", "value": "(?i)\\bvose?\\b"}],
    },
]


def api(base, key, method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{base}/api/v3/{path}",
        data=data,
        method=method,
        headers={"X-Api-Key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
        raw = resp.read()
    return json.loads(raw) if raw else None


def ensure_custom_format(base, key):
    payload = {
        "name": CF_NAME,
        "includeCustomFormatWhenRenaming": False,
        "specifications": SPECIFICATIONS,
    }
    cfs = api(base, key, "GET", "customformat")
    existing = next((c for c in cfs if c["name"] == CF_NAME), None)
    if existing:
        payload["id"] = existing["id"]
        api(base, key, "PUT", f"customformat/{existing['id']}", payload)
        return "updated"
    api(base, key, "POST", "customformat", payload)
    return "created"


def item_names(item):
    if item.get("quality"):
        return [item["quality"]["name"]]
    return [i["quality"]["name"] for i in item.get("items", [])]


def ensure_profile(base, key):
    profiles = api(base, key, "GET", "qualityprofile")
    existing = next((p for p in profiles if p["name"] == PROFILE_NAME), None)
    if existing:
        existing["minFormatScore"] = SCORE
        existing["cutoffFormatScore"] = SCORE
        for fi in existing["formatItems"]:
            if fi["name"] == CF_NAME:
                fi["score"] = SCORE
        api(base, key, "PUT", f"qualityprofile/{existing['id']}", existing)
        return "updated"

    profile = api(base, key, "GET", "qualityprofile/schema")
    profile["name"] = PROFILE_NAME
    profile["upgradeAllowed"] = True
    profile["minFormatScore"] = SCORE
    profile["cutoffFormatScore"] = SCORE
    for item in profile["items"]:
        item["allowed"] = any(n in QUALITIES for n in item_names(item))
        for sub in item.get("items", []):
            sub["allowed"] = sub["quality"]["name"] in QUALITIES
        if CUTOFF in item_names(item):
            profile["cutoff"] = item["quality"]["id"] if item.get("quality") else item["id"]
    for fi in profile["formatItems"]:
        if fi["name"] == CF_NAME:
            fi["score"] = SCORE
    api(base, key, "POST", "qualityprofile", profile)
    return "created"


def main():
    for app in ("RADARR", "SONARR"):
        base = os.environ[f"{app}_URL"]
        key = os.environ[f"{app}_API_KEY"]
        print(f"{app.lower()}: custom format {ensure_custom_format(base, key)}", flush=True)
        print(f"{app.lower()}: quality profile {ensure_profile(base, key)}", flush=True)


main()
